base_template: Write a cybersecurity policy update for the company. Due to brute-force attempts, access to administrative VTY lines is now restricted. Only the Management Station at {{mgmt_ip}} is authorized. Mention that ACL {{acl_number}} will enforce this.

mgmt_ip.instruction: Generate a private management IP (10.x.x.x or 172.16.x.x), last octet between 50 and 150 (avoid .1 and .20)

acl_number.instruction: Generate a random number between 1 and 99 (standard ACL range)

expected_solution: Create standard ACL {{acl_number}} permitting only {{mgmt_ip}}, then apply it to VTY lines with 'access-class {{acl_number}} in'.
